metadata.qos: goal/result/cancel/feedback reliable volatile KeepLast(max(16, goal_window*feedback_per_goal)); status default; result retention 1000 ms
metadata.transport: independent processes, localhost DDS, intra-process disabled
metadata.scheduling: single-threaded executor/spin loop; 100 ms wait cap; goal_window active goals
metadata.protocol: submit the complete goal window; accept all goals; readiness phase 0; server publishes round-robin feedback; client validates all payloads and sends phase 1 ACK; server succeeds every result; final rejected control goal; status and feedback competition is retained
metadata.rtt_boundary: before first goal submission through all accepted goals, readiness handshake, all validated feedback, acknowledgement and all successful results
metadata.feedback_boundary: after accepted-goal retrieval, before readiness phase 0 request, through complete validated round-robin feedback consumption; status and feedback competition is included
metadata.throughput_boundary: all measured batches including full payload validation; excludes discovery, warmup and final control

server_stage_boundaries.accept: wait for and accept the complete goal window
server_stage_boundaries.start_wait: wait for the phase-0 readiness request; includes response send in rclcpp
server_stage_boundaries.execute: transition every accepted goal to executing
server_stage_boundaries.feedback_publish: construct and publish every round-robin feedback payload
server_stage_boundaries.feedback_wait: wait for the phase-1 acknowledgement after complete client validation
server_stage_boundaries.terminal: succeed every goal and publish terminal results/status

build_manifest.batch_api_detection: action_servers/batch.rs contains public execute_batch: use batched accept/execute/terminal status snapshots; absent: identical harness falls back to per-goal operations
build_manifest.benchmark_cfg: --check-cfg=cfg(r2r_bench_action_batches); --cfg enables batched status snapshots only where the public API exists
